verdict.rationale: Dagster is a data orchestration platform, so replication capabilities are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) capture of updates and deletes by Dagster itself. Its Airbyte, Fivetran and dlt integrations only trigger or represent third-party sync tools as assets, which is adjacent support and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I replicate databases with log-based CDC (binlog/WAL) so I capture updates and deletes without hammering the source
